text: N024064March 20, 2008CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:N3:353 CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6104.43.2010 Ms. Irene TsiavosFun World80 Voice Rd.Carle Place, NY 11514RE:	The tariff classification of an adult costume from China, Taiwan, India and Vietnam.Dear Ms. Tsiavos:	In your letter dated February 25, 2008, you requested a classification ruling.  The sample which you submitted is being returned as requested.		Styles 102154 and 102154H Homerun Hottie Costume Set and Styles 102155 and 102155H Homerun Hottie Plus Size Costume Set consist of a dress baseball cap, socks and belt.	“H” items are the same costume packaged on a hanger with a color insert.	 The dress is made of knit 95% polyester/5% spandex fabric.  The pinstripe short dress with short sleeves has ribbon laced sides with metal grommets, drop waist and flare skirt.  The Playboy Rabbit Head is printed on the front and “Playmates” is printed on the back.  The socks are knit 90% acrylic and 10% spandex.  The base ball cap is of woven cotton fabric.	The costume is well made with a finished neck, sturdy waist and seams, hemmed edges and sew-on embellishments.General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(b) is applicable when goods are, prima facie, classifiable under two or more headings, and have been put up in sets for retail sale.  GRI 3(b) states that the goods “shall be classified as if they consisted of the material or component which gives them their essential character.”  In this case, the dress imparts the essential character of the set.	 The applicable subheading for Styles 102394 and 102394H Burlesque Dancer Costume Sets and 102395 and 102395H Plus size Costume Sets will be 6104.43.2010, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for "Women's or girls' suits, ensembles…dresses, skirts, divided skirts, trousers…knitted or crocheted: Dresses: Of synthetic fibers, Other, Women’s." The rate of duty will be 16% ad valorem. The textile category designation is 636.		Even though the socks are included as a constituent part of the set for classification purposes, they still fall within textile category 632.  With the exception of certain products of China, quota/visa requirements are no longer applicable for merchandise which is the product of World Trade Organization (WTO) member countries.  Quota and visa requirements are the result of international agreements that are subject to frequent renegotiations and changes.
